_readme: Everything business-specific lives here. Setup fills it from the owner interview; nothing else in the repo names the business. After editing run: node setup/gen-config.mjs

brand.what_we_do: <one line: what the business does and where>

language._note: On-screen text + voice language. font_script must match a font pair in assets/fonts: <font_prefix>-<font_script>-600/800.ttf and <font_prefix>-latin-600/800.ttf. tts speakers: see SKILL / setup/LANGUAGES.md.

dm.public_reply: Thanks! Message us "Hi" (tap Message on our profile) and we'll send it right away.
public_done: Sent you a DM. Not in your inbox? Check message requests, including hidden requests.
Just messaged you! If you can't see it, look in message requests or hidden requests.
Check your DMs. Instagram sometimes puts it under requests or hidden requests.
dm.follow_ask: Almost there! Please follow us (we share a useful tip every day), then tap the button below and we'll send it right away.
dm.follow_recheck: Hmm, we can't see your follow yet. Open our profile, tap Follow, then tap the button again.
dm.delete_done: Done. We have deleted your conversation and details from our system.
dm.opt_out_reply: No problem. We won't send you any more reminders. If you need us later, just message here.
nudge_open: Hey, just checking in 👋 We were halfway through our chat and didn't want to leave you hanging.
Hi again 🙂 No rush at all. One quick answer and we can take this forward for you.
Last check from our side 🙏 If you'd still like our team to call you, just reply here and we'll pick up where we stopped.
nudge_public: just checking 👋 did our DM reach you? It may be in message requests (or hidden requests). Reply there and we'll take it forward.
quick check 🙂 we sent what you asked for by DM. If you can't see it, look in message requests, then reply there.

bot.never_say: any price, fee, cost, discount or government fee
bot.price_reply: Our team will share the exact quote on a call once they understand your needs.
bot.extra_rules: Never give legal advice beyond general facts.

questions.ask: What does your business do? Tell us in a line or two.
How many people are starting it? Is anyone living abroad?
Does the business already have income, clients or funding?
How soon do you want to get started?
Could you share a phone number so our team can call you?
Would you prefer the call in Malayalam or English?

bot.done: Thank you! 🙏 Our team will call you shortly.

facts: List only facts you have verified from official sources, one per line. Scripts may use nothing else.
content.rules: Never state a service price. Only statutory numbers (penalties, deadlines) may appear.

ui._note: All on-screen words the factory draws. Translate into the content language during setup.
ui.follow_for_more: Follow for more tips like this
ui.quiz_foot: Answer in the next story. Reply with yours
